description: Public-safe pass/gap ledger for every archived AUTOPILOT-DEMO backlog item. Each entry names the enforcing commands, before/after metrics or gap rationale, and behavioral evidence. No timestamps, local paths, or private data.

items.summary: Add a deterministic public quality scorecard for Autopilot cleanup progress across releases.
items.before: No machine-readable quality snapshot; Autopilot progress was prose-only.
items.after: scripts/quality_scorecard.py emits Markdown+JSON; --check gates shape, determinism, and public-safety in CI and /verify; baseline committed to docs/quality/.
items.behavioral_evidence: Two runs against the same tree produce byte-identical output. --check exits nonzero when shape or public-safety invariants are violated.

items.summary: Add a repo-wide public-safety gate for tracked and staged files.
items.before: No automated guard prevented committing tokens, local paths, or private remotes to tracked history.
items.after: scripts/public_safety_scan.py --tracked --staged runs in CI and /verify; matched content is redacted; .verify-state is local-only.
items.behavioral_evidence: Scanner exits 1 when any tracked or staged file contains a token/path/remote pattern. Output never prints matched text verbatim.

items.summary: Reduce transitional Ruff ignores without broad style-only churn.
items.before: 33 global Ruff ignores covering historical suppression debt.
items.after: 3 global Ruff ignores; remaining debt scoped to per-file ignores; new scripts inherit the stricter rule set.
items.behavioral_evidence: ruff check exits 0 with no new inline suppressions introduced. Per-file ignore count is stable.

items.summary: Establish a strict Pyright slice for stable low-level modules.
items.before: Only basic Pyright mode; no strict-mode coverage for any modules.
items.after: pyrightconfig.strict.json covers version.py, mcp_tool_profiles.py, and disk_budget.py; wired into CI and /verify.
items.behavioral_evidence: python -m pyright -p pyrightconfig.strict.json exits 0 from the declared dev environment.

items.summary: Document the public-safe adversarial Claude workflow protocol for repo quality work.
items.before: No public documentation of multi-agent quality-review workflow or review criteria.
items.after: docs/quality/workflow-review-protocol.md documents adversarial review workflow; linked from docs/quality/README.md.
items.behavioral_evidence: Workflow review guard validates the protocol document for required sections and actionable language.

items.summary: Generate a deterministic public-safe code-intelligence packet from real MemPalace CLI output.
items.before: No deterministic code-intelligence demo artifact; demo claims were not reproducible from the repo.
items.after: scripts/gen_code_intelligence_packet.py produces docs/demo/code-intelligence-packet.{md,json}; 464-line test suite validates normalization, known-answer queries, check-mode drift, and cleanup.
items.behavioral_evidence: --check exits nonzero when committed packet drifts from freshly generated output. Tests cover known-answer retrieval queries against a synthetic fixture palace.

items.summary: Close owner-acceptance blockers on the code-intelligence golden packet.
items.before: Scanner-flagged token literal in source, audit evidence at non-public path, missing owner-acceptance checklist.
items.after: Token literal encoded; audit evidence at public-safe path; owner-acceptance checklist in packet generator/artifacts; B905 zip strictness fixed.
items.behavioral_evidence: Public-safety scan passes on committed source. Packet generator --check exits 0. All 12 test suite verifications pass.

items.summary: Add an explicit committed-tree public-safety scan mode for publishable release verification.
items.before: Public-safety gate only covered tracked and staged files; committed HEAD blobs were unchecked before release.
items.after: Added --committed mode scanning HEAD blobs via git objects; redacted failure output; documented pre-commit vs release-readiness scan distinction.
items.behavioral_evidence: python scripts/public_safety_scan.py --committed --tracked --staged exits 0 on clean repository. Four fixture tests prove clean HEAD, secret redaction, local-only artifact rejection, and deleted-worktree boundary.

items.summary: Add real MCP stdio contract tests for profiles, tool discovery, and representative tool calls.
items.before: MCP server tests covered unit handlers only; no real stdio subprocess integration tests.
items.after: TestMCPStdioContracts class with 5 real stdio tests: full/default discovery, minimal profile filtering, include/exclude precedence, hidden-tool error, invalid-profile startup.
items.behavioral_evidence: Tests launch the MCP server as a real subprocess and exchange JSON-RPC over stdio. All 5 contract tests pass without network access.

items.summary: Expand the quality scorecard with metrics for gates that matter to the public demo.
items.before: Scorecard schema v1 lacked strict-slice, public-safety, and demo-gate metrics.
items.after: Schema v2 adds strict-slice coverage, public-safety gate status, and demo-gate inventory; 12 new tests; committed artifacts regenerated.
items.behavioral_evidence: python scripts/quality_scorecard.py --check exits 0 with v3 schema and all required metric sections present.

items.summary: Add an automated docs drift guard for CLI commands, MCP tools, optional extras, and release gates.
items.before: No automated check that public docs (README, CLAUDE.md, RELEASING.md) matched the actual CLI commands, MCP tools, optional extras, or release gate workflow names.
items.after: scripts/docs_drift_guard.py validates argparse-derived CLI inventory, MCP tools/profiles, optional extras, release workflow names, and canonical verification commands against public docs.
items.behavioral_evidence: Guard exits 1 with per-surface diff when any documented command string or tool name diverges from the live source. Live docs aligned.

items.summary: Build subprocess-level golden CLI scenarios that prove real user workflows, not only unit internals.
items.before: CLI tests covered unit handlers; no subprocess-level golden scenario coverage of init/mine/search/backup/restore end-to-end.
items.after: tests/test_cli_golden_scenarios.py covers init, mine, status, search, read, export, import, backup, restore plus guard paths as real subprocess invocations.
items.behavioral_evidence: All golden scenarios run as real subprocess calls. Tests exit 0 when the CLI behaves as documented and fail when guard paths are violated.

items.summary: Harden external-input boundaries with focused abuse-case tests for paths, archives, JSONL, YAML, and command preflight.
items.before: No dedicated security-boundary tests for path traversal in archives, malformed JSONL, invalid project config, or command preflight abuse cases.
items.after: BackupArchiveError/unsafe_archive_member, JsonlInputError/malformed_jsonl, InvalidProjectConfigError/invalid_project_config, and security_boundary_* tests in place.
items.behavioral_evidence: All security_boundary_* tests pass. Abuse cases (path traversal in archive members, malformed JSONL, invalid config) raise the documented exception types.

items.summary: Add an import-boundary guard so core modules cannot depend on CLI, MCP, or optional legacy backend layers.
items.before: No import-boundary enforcement; core modules could accidentally import CLI, MCP, or optional backend layers.
items.after: scripts/architecture_guard.py enforces layer isolation; tests validate allowed/forbidden import pairs; wired into CI and /verify.
items.behavioral_evidence: Guard exits 1 when any core module imports a CLI, MCP, or optional layer. Four contract-named tests cover boundary enforcement.

items.summary: Expand the strict Pyright slice to config, reader, and mining/scanner modules.
items.before: Strict slice covered 3 modules (version.py, mcp_tool_profiles.py, disk_budget.py).
items.after: Strict slice expanded to 6 modules: added config.py, reader.py, mining/scanner.py with typed boundaries.
items.behavioral_evidence: python -m pyright -p pyrightconfig.strict.json exits 0 with all 6 modules in the strict include list.

items.summary: Add deterministic performance budgets for mining, search, read, and maintenance on synthetic fixtures.
items.before: No performance gates; mining/search/read latency could regress silently between releases.
items.after: benchmarks/demo_perf_budgets.py --check --ci enforces hard latency budgets on synthetic fixtures; 10 unit tests validate budget enforcement logic.
items.behavioral_evidence: --check --ci exits nonzero when any measured operation exceeds its budget. All 10 unit tests and 6 scorecard tests pass.

items.summary: Add a lightweight guard that workflow review summaries are actionable rather than ceremonial.
items.before: Workflow review summaries had no enforced structure; ceremonial wording could satisfy the form without actionable findings.
items.after: Guard validates workflow-review-protocol.md for required sections, actionable language, and absence of vague approval phrases; 33 tests pass.
items.behavioral_evidence: All 33 workflow review guard tests pass. Protocol document wording was updated to replace insufficient phrasing.

items.summary: Canonicalize all AUTOPILOT-DEMO gates, add built-artifact inspection, installed-provenance smoke, and a public evidence ledger.
commands: python -m pytest tests/test_gate_inventory.py tests/test_release_artifact_gate.py tests/test_release_readiness_gate.py tests/test_release_install_metadata_smoke.py tests/test_installed_artifact_behavior.py tests/test_autopilot_demo_gate_ledger.py tests/test_pyright_optional_dependencies.py -q
items.before: Gate commands were scattered across CLAUDE.md, CI YAML, and scorecard metadata; no canonical single source; built artifacts not inspected before release; install smoke used sys.executable -m pipx.
items.after: scripts/gate_inventory.py is the single canonical source; release_artifact_gate.py inspects wheel and sdist member lists; release_readiness_gate.py orchestrates build+artifact+smoke; install smoke discovers pipx via PATH and Homebrew fallback.
items.behavioral_evidence: gate_inventory.py --check exits 0 when CI and /verify docs match all canonical commands. Artifact gate rejects .codex-local, .tasks, .protocols, caches, .verify-state, and confirms wheel and sdist both pass twine check. Install smoke reports package_metadata/module_version/cli_version_check agreement from a disposable venv and a pipx install discovered independently of the target interpreter. At task closure, release_readiness_gate.py --check --json returned ok; the separately executed basic and strict Pyright, public safety, scorecard, docs-drift, architecture, performance budget, and full non-network pytest gates also passed.
